name: Custom instructions
note: Standing instructions set in the app, not in code
summary: Standing instructions a user writes in a product's settings, or attaches to a project or folder. The product adds them to every session or task in that scope, so tone, format and background don't have to be repeated in each prompt. Changing them needs no code change or deploy.
how: Write tone, format and background about your role in the app's settings
Optionally add narrower instructions to a project or folder
The product applies them at the start of every session in that scope
Edit them in the app whenever they need to change
facts: Claude Cowork (global, folder and project instructions)
Editable without a deploy, but usually kept in app settings rather than in version control
goodFor: People shaping an agent without writing code
Preferences that apply to every task
watchOut: Instructions are guidance, not enforced rules
Hard to review or share when kept only in app settings
Global and project instructions can overlap or conflict
